# Coral Gables Executive Physicians

Concierge Internal Medicine & Primary Care located in Coral Gables, FL

## About Coral Gables Executive Physicians

Coral Gables Executive Physicians in Coral Gables, Florida, is a one-stop-shop for high-quality, comprehensive, and preventive primary medical care. The medical team, led by board-certified internal medicine physician Robert H. Thomas, MD, FACP, operates under a patient-first treatment philosophy and the understanding that no two people are alike or have the same health care needs. Every patient receives personalized medicine with customized treatment plans specific to their needs.

Patients receive comprehensive care and accurate diagnoses, as the facility partners with the best laboratories, stays up-to-date on the latest advancements and best treatment practices, and uses modern health care technologies. It is not uncommon for other medical practices and hospitals to send patients for a consultation at Coral Gables Executive Physicians when they are unable to diagnose their condition.

The practice is both comfortable and luxurious, and the entire medical staff is friendly and knowledgeable, putting even anxious patients at ease from the moment they walk into the building.

In addition to diagnosis and treatment of common medical disorders such as: diabetes, hypertension, heart disease and a wide variety of preventive care, the practice also offers specialty testing such as food sensitivities, nutrient testing, genetic testing, etc. The practice also offers same-day and Saturday appointments as well as 24/7 telephone access to the physician.

For an appointment, call the practice today.

# Coral Gables Cardiology Associates

## Concierge Internal Medicine & Cardiologists serving Coral Gables, FL and the greater Miami, Florida area.

* * *

Coral Gables Cardiology Associates, in Coral Gables, Florida, is a full-service concierge internal medical practice focused on patient wellness. The physicians are board-certified in internal medicine and cardiovascular disease and hold attending privileges at South Miami Hospital and Doctors Hospital. They are located in the heart of Coral Gables, just outside of the main business district.

The physicians and staff are dedicated to patient care; a physician is always on call for medical concerns, and the staff is experienced and trained to address patient needs. They have an on-site lab for point-of-care diagnostic testing, as well as a fully equipped echocardiogram, imaging, and stress test lab. They serve as the coordinator of care for their patients, working with other specialists to craft appropriate approaches to often complex medical concerns.

In addition to 24-hour physician availability, Coral Gables Cardiology Associates offers same-day care for patients who need to be seen and also serves as hospitalists for patients who need to be admitted to either South Miami Hospital or Doctors Hospital.

Coral Gables Cardiology Associates has particular expertise with amateur, elite, and professional athletes. The team has proudly served as the Miami Heat’s team internists and cardiologists for over 30 years and has worked with athletes from MLS, NBA, WNBA, and NCAA, as well as professional boxers. They bring this experience to their work with athletes at every level, assisting patients in optimizing health and performance.

To learn more about concierge care at Coral Gables Cardiology Associates, simply call the office.

- Our Mission



Coral Gables Cardiology Associates is a three-physician concierge medical practice with a specialty in Internal Medicine and Cardiovascular Disease.



Our physicians and staff provide a personal and direct approach to health care with a focus on preventative medicine and wellness.





**We are always here – ready to support our patients.**


Our physicians hold attending privileges at South Miami Hospital and Doctors Hospital

Coral Gables Cardiology Associates is a full-service concierge medical practice

Our physicians are available 24-hours a day, seven days a week to address medical concerns.

### VO2 Max

- Experts in Athlete Health & Performance



Coral Gables Cardiology Associates, P.A. has treated amateur, elite and professional athletes for over 30 years.  Our player exams include annual sports physicals as well as detailed cardiac evaluations. If you are an athlete with a known medical condition, our sports cardiologists will help safely get you back on the field.







If you are looking to maximize performance, you may benefit from a VO2 max cardiopulmonary assessment.  The test provides accurate data about your cardiovascular fitness as well as the intensity of exercise at various heart rate zones, and can be used to guide your training program.



[Learn More](https://www.coralgablescardiology.com/services/vo2-max-assessment)


Our patients have access to an onsite laboratory that conducts point-of-care diagnostic tests for immediate results.

[Contact us to learn more!](https://www.coralgablescardiology.com/contactus)

**How HSA Hospitals uses cookies**

NecessaryAlways Active

**Essential website cookies**

These cookies are necessary to provide you with the core services and features available through the HSA Hospitals website. Because these cookies are necessary to deliver the website as intended, you cannot refuse them without impacting how the site functions.

No cookies to display.

Functional

Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

No cookies to display.

Analytics

**Social Media Cookies**

These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools. If enabled, these cookies may allow social media platforms to track your activity. HSA Hospitals does not control how these platforms use your data. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies.

No cookies to display.

Performance

**Performance cookies**

These cookies are used to enhance the functionality of the HSA Hospitals website. They help us customize the site and related applications to enhance your user experience. Although these cookies improve the site’s performance, they are not essential to its use. However, without these cookies, certain items may be unavailable or may not work as intended.

No cookies to display.

Advertisement

**Advertising (targeting) cookies**

These cookies are used to help us deliver advertising that is more relevant to you and your interests. They also help ensure that ads are properly displayed, that the same ad doesn’t continue to reappear, and that the ads you see are related to your interests. We may use cookies to understand user engagement within our content. HSA Hospitals does not use cookies for personalized advertising based on health or medical information.

No cookies to display.

# Coral Gables

As this region continues to flourish and evolve, HSA Health Care is proud to welcome Coral Gables Hospital into our physician-owned-and-led family

## Our Services

### Coral Gables Hospital

![](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/ambulance-1005433_1280-1024x681.jpg)

#### [Emergency Care](https://coralgableshospital.org/emergency-care/)

Our safe and ready Emergency Department in Port Arthur combines world class medical expertise with first-in-class safety

![A Healthcare Worker Measuring a Patient's Blood Pressure Using a Sphygmomanometer](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pexels-photo-7659573-7659573-1024x683.jpg)

#### [Cardiology](https://coralgableshospital.org/cardiology/)

Coral Gables Hospital offers the latest diagnostic tools to provide accurate detection of heart conditions.

![](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/orthopedic-surgery-7817270_1280-1-1024x682.jpg)

#### [Orthopedics](https://coralgableshospital.org/orthopedics/)

Coral Gables Hospital’s orthopedic specialists can offer you some of the latest minimally invasive procedures for everything

![](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/surgery-2058088_1280-768x576.jpg)

#### [Urology](https://coralgableshospital.org/urology/)

Whether you come to Coral Gables Hospital for a routine prostate exam or you’re interested in a surgical solution for erectile dysfunction

![](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/happens-736244_1280-1024x686.jpg)

#### [Breast Cancer](https://coralgableshospital.org/breast-cancer/)

Coral Gables Hospital offers patients access to comprehensive and coordinated breast health, education, diagnostics, and treatment services

![](https://coralgableshospital.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/ai-generated-8894223_1280-1024x574.jpg)

#### [Diagnostic Imaging](https://coralgableshospital.org/diagnostic-imaging/)

Coral Gables Hospital offers diagnostic services using the best digital imaging equipment so you can receive a diagnosis and treatment as quickly as possible

[View All Services](https://coralgableshospital.org/services/)

# Welcome to Our Practice

At Prime Care of Coral Gables, we recognize that you have a choice when it comes to your family's healthcare provider. This website contains information about our doctors, locations, hours, emergency practices and more. The more you
know, the more comfortable we hope you will be.

We believe our website is the best way for you to stay connected to our practice and get the highest quality of care possible. We also provide 24/7 access to an array of information on many common healthcare topics.

On behalf of all our professionals and staff, we welcome you to our practice, and look forward to helping you and your family preserve a lifetime of good health.
